messages:
Marta: flagging an SDK vs REST parity bug I hit while wiring up the new reranker sample.
Ryan: quick summary?
Marta: REST /v1/rerank accepts `candidate_set` + `timeout_ms` and honors the timeout. The TypeScript SDK call `client.rerank()` silently ignores `timeout_ms` and instead expects `request_timeout` (old name).
Li: oh no, param drift. Where does it get dropped?
Marta: SDK shape validation strips unknown keys, so when you pass `timeout_ms` it fails schema check and the network layer sends payload without any timeout field. Server falls back to default 10s -> flaky tests.
Ryan: any evidence?
Marta: repro curl vs SDK: 
```bash
# REST (respects timeout)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"candidate_set":["a","b"],"timeout_ms":500}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank | jq .duration_ms
# SDK (no timeout sent)
node -e "(async ()=>{ const r = await client.rerank({candidate_set:['a','b'], timeout_ms:500}); console.log('ok', r); })()"
```
Marta: server logs show request without timeout on SDK path.
sdk-bot: [lint] SDK param schema mismatch detected for rerank in redwood-ts v0.9.2
Li: looks like the TS SDK's interface was updated but we missed keeping alternate param names for backward compatibility.
Ryan: is this just a naming mismatch or are there other behavioral diffs?
Marta: two more: 1) REST returns `scores` as floats, SDK coerces to strings (breaking numeric aggregation in sample app), 2) SDK auto-retries on 5xx using exponential backoff even when caller set `no_retry: true` in options. The REST client honors `no_retry`.
Li: risky. Auto-retry semantics breaking tests and causing duplicate downstream effects.
Ryan: prioritize: a) accept both `timeout_ms` and `request_timeout` in SDK layer, b) fix types to return numeric `scores`, c) respect explicit `no_retry` from caller.
Marta: propose quick patches: small adapter in SDK input serializer to map known REST param aliases, add unit tests asserting server receives correct raw body, and add e2e that compares SDK vs curl output for `scores` numeric typing.
Li: I'll open PRs. Also CI: sample-rerank e2e timed out on branch deploy -> ci-bot had a failure.
ci-bot: [automation] e2e/sample-rerank failed on job 8212 (timeout)
Ryan: can we also add a parity test into our SDK nightly regression suite that does HTTP vs SDK roundtrip for a handful of endpoints (chat, embeddings, rerank)?
Marta: yes, but keep it lightweight. Nightly tests should run curl -> compare key fields. I'll draft the test harness.
Li: security note: when adding alias mapping, avoid silently accepting unknown fields. We should whitelist the aliases and log a deprecation warning for deprecated names.
Ryan: agreed. Add telemetry event for param alias usage so we can track clients relying on old names.
Marta: created ticket RDW-1305 with repro logs and suggested fix. PR link will be in the ticket.
Li: any docs updates? The sample app docs referenced `timeout_ms` in examples; we need to keep examples consistent with SDK surface.
Marta: I'll update sample app docs to show both forms and add a short note in SDK migration guide.
Ryan: timeline?
Marta: hotfix for alias mapping + `no_retry` fix today (patch). Numeric scores fix likely requires small change to deserializer, target tomorrow.
Li: I'll also add the parity check to nightly and a failing test in unit suite to prevent regression.
Marta: thanks. One more oddball: someone reported ephemeral auth header name mismatch. REST always uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>` while some SDK flows send `X-Redwood-Ephemeral` for browser sessions; server accepts both but some middleboxes drop `X-` headers. Recommend SDK normalize to `Authorization` for browser helper.
Ryan: good catch — include that in the hotfix PR as well.
Marta: PRs: will link once up. Keeping this thread open until CI green on the e2e.
